CURRENT WRITTEN-PROVISION REVIEW · 31 OCTOBER 2026

Teach it. Practise it. Check it.

All 519 detailed unit-content items have teaching, a worked example, independent formative practice and feedback nominated in 111 reviewed demand groups.

2026 foundation retained; Year 11 uses the teaching-from-2026 syllabus and Year 12 the teaching-from-2027 syllabus. This confirms written provision in the linked resources. It does not claim that every student has executed a practical, that a school has adopted an assessment outline, or that an independent teacher has signed off.

Download all 519 evidence rows · CSV Required, support and enrichment

The 13 initially partial groups have been rechecked against their follow-up lessons. Earlier judgements remain visible as historical records. Parent bullets supply context to their detailed children and are not counted twice. Editorial IDs are local locators; read the linked official source for exact scope.
